# blastshield_device_security_posture (Resource)

Manages a Blastshield device_security_posture.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "blastshield_device_security_posture" "desktop" {
  name         = "Desktop Device"
  windows_attr = {}
  macos_attr   = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `android_attr` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--android_attr))
- `ios_attr` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ios_attr))
- `linux_attr` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--linux_attr))
- `macos_attr` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--macos_attr))
- `pinned_devices` (Set of String)
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags for the resource. Merged over the provider default_tags; on key conflicts these take precedence.
- `windows_attr` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows_attr))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `system_tags` (Map of String)
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags on the resource: the provider default_tags merged with tags, where tags take precedence.
